profiles.title: Computer Science and Engineering Graduate
profiles.bioSummary: Computer Science and Engineering graduate with practical experience in MIS reporting, data analysis, business intelligence, and technical operations. Proficient in Python, SQL, Advanced Excel, and Power BI, with knowledge of data cleaning, exploratory data analysis, dashboard development, and reporting automation.
profiles.careerInterests: Open to opportunities across technical, analytical, business, reporting, operations, and technology-related fields.

about.headline: Dedicated to turning raw data into strategic business intelligence.
bioParagraphs: I am a Computer Science and Engineering graduate with hands-on experience in MIS reporting, data analysis, business intelligence, and operational analytics. Through corporate execution at Indiavision Realty & Infrastructure and specialized analytics at GRAStech, I specialize in transforming fragmented operational datasets into high-fidelity dashboards and streamlined automated reporting pipelines.

My core analytical stack centers around Python (Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Scikit-learn), robust SQL query authoring for complex joins and aggregations, Microsoft Power BI for dynamic executive KPI visualization, and Advanced Excel utilizing nested XLOOKUPs, dynamic Pivot Tables, and automated macros. I am passionate about identifying systemic bottlenecks and bridging business requirements with reliable data solutions.
about.careerObjectives: To leverage my strong analytical, technical, and problem-solving skills in high-impact data analytics, business intelligence, or software engineering roles where I can drive operational efficiency and data-informed decision making.

responsibilities: Generate and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports for executive management.
Use Advanced Excel functions, including VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, dynamic Pivot Tables, and conditional formulas.
Maintain data accuracy through systematic data validation and anomaly detection techniques.
Collect, reconcile, and clean cross-departmental datasets from sales, CRM, and accounts.
Identify operational bottlenecks across workflows and recommend data-backed mitigation strategies.
Automate routine reporting tasks and weekly spreadsheet consolidations to save engineering hours.
Cleaned and transformed heterogeneous raw datasets using Python, SQL, Excel, and Power BI.
Performed exploratory data analysis (EDA) using Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, and Seaborn to isolate critical business drivers.
Developed interactive Power BI dashboards featuring DAX measures, customized slicers, and KPI cards.
Used SQL queries for data extraction, multi-table joins, subqueries, filtering, and aggregation summarisation.
Applied data validation and preprocessing techniques to eliminate nulls, outliers, and duplicates.
Presented analytical findings through clear executive visualisations and structured analytical reports.

projects.title: Bank Loan Analysis Dashboard
projects.description: Developed an interactive business intelligence dashboard to analyse bank loan data, monitor loan performance, and identify trends in loan approvals and defaults.
features: Loan data preparation & schema normalization
Executive KPI development (Total Funded Amount, Received Amount, Avg DTI)
Interactive Power BI dashboard with dynamic cross-filtering and drill-through

projects.title: E-Commerce Sales Analysis
projects.description: Analysed e-commerce sales data to understand sales performance, customer purchasing patterns, and actionable business insights using Python and statistical modeling.
features: Automated data importing from multi-source CSVs
RFM customer segmentation & regional demand analysis
High-impact data visualisations using Matplotlib, Seaborn, and Plotly

projects.title: MIS Cross-Departmental Reporting Automation
projects.description: An automated workflow system that reconciles, cleans, and generates scheduled operational reports for multi-department real estate sales and inventory metrics.
features: Automated data reconciliation from diverse departments
Dynamic XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, and automated error-checking routines
Scheduled summary generation for executive decision-makers
Operational bottleneck detection and anomaly alerts

projects.title: Retail Store Inventory & Sales Forecasting
projects.description: Predictive analysis and inventory optimization engine applying machine learning regression to forecast weekly stock demands and reduce inventory holding costs.
features: Historical time-series trend extraction
Linear Regression and Random Forest demand forecasting
Stockout risk mitigation matrices and safety stock recommendations
Interactive visual reporting with interactive sliders

projects.title: Customer Churn Analysis & Retention Modeling
projects.description: Exploratory data analysis and predictive classification to identify at-risk enterprise customers and recommend targeted retention workflows.
features: Feature correlation analysis
Churn probability scoring
Interactive BI churn dashboard
Automated reporting pipeline

projects.title: Financial Risk & Investment Portfolio Tracker
projects.description: Comprehensive financial performance and risk monitoring dashboard tracking asset returns, volatility metrics, and asset allocation breakdown.
features: Real-time KPI variance calculation
Dynamic asset weight rebalancing
Historical drawdown analysis
Executive summary PDF export
